decisions.label: b
decisions.why: np.where(np.array(v) > 0, 1, 0) builds an int64 array; np.packbits takes the bool array directly. Same packed values.

what_it_does: computes page embeddings with the model

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Passing batch_size to the DataLoader changes padding and so floating-point results, and the model needs a download and a GPU; the output could not be shown identical.

what_it_does: logs a terminal write and echoes it if verbose and not filtered

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: re.match runs for every chunk even when _verbose is false and nothing is printed. Testing _verbose first skips it. If _filter_pattern is None the original raises TypeError on every write while the repair raises only when verbose; checks will say whether that matters.

what_it_does: creates parent directories and writes a file from a command spec

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `os.path.sep.join(path_array)` is built twice per component and each level stats a directory; one os.makedirs(dirname, exist_ok=True) creates the same directories. Small file-system effect.

what_it_does: repeats a command until its output contains an expected string

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: `if waited >= max_wait` after the loop is always true; the condition is dead. Trivial; the 5 s sleeps are idle time, not CPU.

what_it_does: returns the content of the latest message of a given type

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The messagetype comparison is repeated per message; resolve the class once before the loop. Small.

what_it_does: parses condition strings into Vespa query-builder conditions

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The operators dict can only be hoisted to module level or into a default argument; the latter is a mutable default that adds a parameter. The cost is seven small lambdas next to string splitting and query-builder calls.

what_it_does: builds an LLM chain and runs it for keyword generation

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: ChatOpenAI client, parser, prompt and chain are constructed on every call although the inputs vary only at invoke time. A cache on the function object builds them once. Needs an OpenAI key to run.

what_it_does: returns a training example with rotating positive and negative documents

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: pop(0) and append on lists of ids rotate in O(n); a deque rotates in O(1). The lists belong to self.queries, built only in __init__ and read only here (grep), so __init__ converts them and __getitem__ uses rotate.

what_it_does: loads documents and queries from JSONL files

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: readlines() builds a list of all lines walked once; iterate the file instead.

what_it_does: queries Vespa for hard negatives of one query

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The nearestNeighbor request is sent before checking that the query has positives, and the result is discarded when it has none; check first. Needs a live Vespa.

what_it_does: samples equally spaced frames from a list of frames

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: np.array(images) stacks every frame to pick a few; stacking only the indexed frames gives the same array.

what_it_does: reads all frames of a video and samples some

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The imageio reader is never closed; closing it releases the file handle. Needs a video file.

what_it_does: computes one CLIP embedding per sampled frame

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Batching frames through CLIP changes kernel shapes and so low-order float bits, and CLIP must be downloaded.

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: ntpath.basename(video_file_name) is constant in the loop; hoist it. The unit needs the CLIP model to construct, so it may not run.

what_it_does: fetches the predefined queries file over HTTP on every rerun

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: A Streamlit rerun repeats the same GET for a static file; caching the function result keeps the data. Network.

what_it_does: writes user documents built from order data

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: All 1.4M merged rows are grouped although only `limit` users are written when not full. Restricting to the first `limit` sorted user ids before the groupby gives the same documents in the same order.

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: iterrows builds a Series per purchase row; building the dicts from column arrays gives the same ints.

what_it_does: writes order documents with product lists

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: When not full, only `limit` orders are written but all order_products rows are sorted and aggregated; filter them to the first `limit` order ids first. Left merge preserves order, so the first `limit` rows are the same.

what_it_does: converts Amazon metadata lines to a Vespa JSON array

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: sys.stdin.readlines() holds all lines before the loop; iterating stdin gives the same lines lazily. Measured card result: depends on size.

what_it_does: converts Amazon review lines to a Vespa JSON array

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: sys.stdin.readlines() holds all lines before the loop; iterate stdin instead.

what_it_does: reads a ground-truth file of ids and distances

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The file is opened and never closed; use `with`. No change to the arrays returned.

what_it_does: cross-validates a LightGBM model and exports it as JSON

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The model JSON is dumped, rewritten by one re.sub per feature, reloaded with json.loads and dumped again. The rewritten string is already the JSON text json.dump would produce, so writing it directly removes loads and the second dump.

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: valid_sets=[lgb_train, lgb_val] makes LightGBM log training AUC every 100 rounds; dropping it removes log output, which is part of the contract.

what_it_does: cross-validates a logistic regression with feature statistics and fold metrics

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: describe() computes the quantiles per column and builds a Series; one agg(['mean','std','min','max']) gives the same four printed numbers.

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: predict and predict_proba each recompute the decision function; one decision_function with a sign test and expit gives the same predictions and probabilities.

what_it_does: builds and sends a Vespa query for car results

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Both branches of `if key in ['make','model']` produce the same f-string because key is already lowercase in that branch; a single branch gives the same list.

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: Removing trace.level changes the request sent and the response returned, which is part of the contract.

what_it_does: returns a car image url from cache or Wikipedia

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: get_wikipedia_image already stores IMAGE_CACHE[cache_key] on every path that returns a url, so the store at the end of get_car_image rewrites the same value. Network is needed on a cold cache.

what_it_does: reads the system prompt file

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The prompt file is read from disk on every chat request; an lru_cache returns the same text while the file is unchanged. Callers see no difference unless the file is edited while running.

what_it_does: fetches an image from Wikipedia

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The cache key is built and tested at the top although get_car_image, its only caller (grep), has just done the same test. Network call; the test is cheap, so the saving is a dict lookup.

what_it_does: returns the blobs of a bucket

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: storage.Client() is built on every request; a cached client reuses credentials and the HTTP session. Needs GCP credentials.

what_it_does: downloads and decompresses matching log blobs

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Independent downloads run one after another; a thread pool overlaps the waits and map keeps order. Needs GCP.

what_it_does: posts each query group to a search endpoint and writes ranked results

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: iterrows builds a Series per row only to keep the last query value; `.iloc[-1]` gives the same value. Needs a live endpoint.

what_it_does: queries Vespa for news

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: requests.post opens a new connection per call; a shared Session reuses it. Needs a live endpoint.

what_it_does: encodes text tokens with CLIP and projects the end-of-text position

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: ln_final normalises all 77 positions before one row per sample is picked. LayerNorm acts per position, so gathering first and normalising the picked rows gives the same values with 77x less normalisation. Needs the clip package and model weights.

what_it_does: sends 13 query variants built per row to Vespa and an LLM and returns one result

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Twelve of the thirteen request dicts are built per row and never used; keep the one that is sent. Needs a live Vespa and LLM.

what_it_does: returns the label whose name appears in a model answer

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: label_names is a module-level list; making it a set needs a module-level change outside the unit and the list has about ten entries, so the saving cannot be measured against the LLM call.

what_it_does: syncs a Vespa index with a feed

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: After a full removal the same ids are removed again one HTTP DELETE at a time; clearing the stale id set skips them. Needs a live Vespa.

what_it_does: deletes each document id with one HTTP call

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: DELETEs are independent and run serially; a pool overlaps the waits. On a busy host this may raise energy, so the form is to be decided with measurement. Needs a live Vespa.

what_it_does: syncs a Vespa index with feed files

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: After full removal the same ids are removed again with one curl per id; clearing the id set skips them.

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: Each feed file is parsed in get_feed_docids and again in vespa_feed; parse once and pass the list. Needs curl and a server.

what_it_does: runs a curl subprocess for one HTTP call

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Replacing curl with requests changes stderr output, exceptions and return bytes in ways the unit's callers rely on, and the call needs a server. Near-miss: contract changes.

what_it_does: strips control characters from text

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: A per-character generator calls unicodedata.category for every character. str.translate with a table that caches the decision per character gives the same string and moves the loop into C.

what_it_does: feeds images from a dataset to Vespa

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Each image is saved as JPEG, read back as bytes and decoded again from disk; encoding once to memory, writing the bytes and reusing them removes a read and a file decode. Needs datasets and a server.
